# Lint rules

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_docs_reference.py from the code. Do not edit by hand: run python3 tools/gen_docs_reference.py -->

This page lists the rules that `trials lint` checks in the declarations of every experiment. A script writes the page from the rule lists in the code, so it matches the code of this version.

## How the lint runs

Each rule is one or more pytest tests. `trials lint` runs the general rules first and then the rules of the project's [[backends|backend]]. `trials lint --experiment <name>` lints one experiment, and the rules over shared files still run. Other flags go to pytest, so `trials lint -k <test name>` runs the tests of one rule. `trials validate` runs the lint as one of its stages.

A rule id is `L` and a number. `L4b` is a second part of `L4`. The numbers are shared by both lists, so the ROS 2 rules fill the gaps in the general list.

## General rules

These rules run for every project, from `robofacts/robofacts/lint.py`.

| Rule | What it checks | Test |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `L1` | level_values may only map declared levels. | `test_level_values_map_declared_levels_only` |
| `L3` | an `internal` factor must be CONSUMED by some command template, else it is recorded in the metadata but never applied. | `test_internal_factors_are_actually_consumed` |
| `L4` | every {placeholder} in a command must be a declared factor (or {bag} in a verify step or the action: the runner hands both the trial's bag directory, which is how a flight script knows where to write its flight-time commanded_waypoints.json). | `test_command_placeholders_are_declared_factors` |
| `L4b` | `the same for a campaign's own setup_steps (a reset step between repeated trials): {factor} or {arg_<launch argument>}, never {bag}, because setup runs before the trial has a bag.` | `test_campaign_setup_step_placeholders_are_declared_factors` |
| `L6` | every experiment must declare verify_steps in runner.yaml, or say why it has none with `no_verify_steps: <reason>`. | `test_every_experiment_declares_a_verify_step` |
| `L7` | a command may not reference a script that does not exist. | `test_commands_reference_scripts_that_exist` |
| `L8` | a campaign's preflight_checklist must exist and be coherent. | `test_campaign_preflight_checklists_exist_and_validate` |
| `L9` | every record profile (and every record_profile factor level) must be a legal value of the metadata contract's enum. | `test_every_record_profile_is_a_legal_metadata_level` |
| `L10` | `every campaign must LOAD — or be refused only because it asks for a level the factor space declares blocked: — and must record every factor it sweeps as a coverage axis of the metadata contract (the invariant plan and run enforce).` | `test_campaigns_load_or_only_ask_for_a_blocked_level` |
| `L12` | a factor of `maps_to.kind: gate` (levels that bind, shadow or disable the T-0 gate per trial) is allowed only in an experiment whose runner.yaml declares `simulation: true`. | `test_gate_factors_only_in_simulated_experiments` |
| `L13` | a factor of `maps_to.kind: operator` (a level the operator realizes by hand, such as the room's lighting) must declare a `check` (a preflight check with per-level arguments, added to every trial's T-0 gate) or an explicit `unchecked: <reason>`. | `test_operator_factors_declare_a_check_or_why_not` |
| `L14` | every runner.yaml declares `simulation: true|false` explicitly. | `test_runner_declares_its_domain` |
| `L15` | a campaign's spoken cues (`voice_cues`, `voice_announce`) are well formed (campaign_spec.voice_problems, also enforced by L10), every {placeholder} in their text is a declared factor, and no cue is planned at or after runner.yaml's `action_timeout_s`: the runner stops the timeline when the action ends, so such a cue would never be spoken, and the operator who waits for it would wait in vain. | `test_voice_cues_are_speakable` |

## Rules of the ROS 2 backend

These rules are facts about ROS 2. They run after the general rules for a project whose backend is `ros2`, from `robofacts_ros2/robofacts_ros2/lint_ros2.py`.

| Rule | What it checks | Test |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `L2` | a launch_arg factor must name an argument the launch file declares. | `test_launch_arg_factors_name_real_launch_arguments` |
| `L5` | a campaign's pre-flight operator_steps must not start ROS processes: a trial's setup steps tear down the previous stack first (scripts/kill_ros.sh, which matches /opt/ros/ and any \*_ws/install/, or an experiment's own stop script), so anything the operator starts beforehand is killed by the trial it was started for. | `test_pre_flight_operator_steps_do_not_start_ros_processes` |
| `L11` | every record profile, and every explicit record_topics list, must record /rosout. | `test_every_record_profile_records_rosout`<br>`test_explicit_record_topics_record_rosout` |
| `L16` | on a real robot (`simulation: false`), runner.yaml's `explore:` block may not open every parameter. | `test_explore_does_not_open_every_parameter_of_a_real_robot` |

## Counts

The general list has 12 rules and the part L4b. The ROS 2 list has 4 rules. Together they hold 17 rule ids and 18 tests.
